title.en: A chiller broken for three weeks

summary.en: Vegetables and sauces are prepared the day before and kept overnight in a chiller that stopped working; the repair request is pending.
summary.id: Sayur dan bumbu disiapkan sehari sebelumnya dan disimpan semalam di chiller yang sudah mati; permintaan perbaikan belum dijawab.

fields.menu: Nasi, ayam suwir, sambal goreng buncis, melon

evidence.label: Repair request form dated 21 September, status pending

reports.narrative: Chiller dapur sudah tiga minggu mati, layar suhunya 19 derajat. Bumbu dan buncis disiapkan sore sebelumnya.

evidence.label: Sour-smelling sambal goreng separated from the tray

reports.narrative: Sambal gorengnya asam, guru menyuruh anak-anak tidak memakannya.

signals.headline: Siswa diduga jajan sembarangan di luar sekolah
signals.excerpt: Koordinator wilayah menyebut kemungkinan siswa mengonsumsi jajanan di luar sekolah sebelum makan siang.

witness_script.question: Bahan apa saja yang disiapkan sehari sebelumnya dan di mana disimpan?
witness_script.answer: Buncis dipotong dan bumbu sambal goreng diulek sore hari, lalu masuk chiller. Chillernya mati sejak akhir September.

witness_script.question: Apakah kerusakan sudah dilaporkan?
witness_script.answer: Sudah, formulir perbaikan kami kirim 21 September. Sampai sekarang belum ada teknisi.

witness_script.question: Apakah siswa jajan di luar sebelum makan?
witness_script.answer: Hari itu gerbang ditutup sampai jam makan, tidak ada yang jajan.

root_cause.statement: Pre-prepared vegetables and sauces are stored overnight in a broken chiller (around 19 °C).

contributing.statement: A repair request filed three weeks earlier was never acted on.
Prep is done the day before instead of the same morning.

answer_key.pattern: Complaints start after the chiller failed and hit dishes prepared the day before; cooked-the-same-morning dishes are fine.
distractors: Pupils eating street snacks (the gate was closed until lunch).
